entities.summary: Arden University is a private, for-profit teaching university in the United Kingdom. It offers a variety of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes with both blended and online distance learning delivery options. Its head office is in Coventry with campus locations in Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, London, Newcastle, Nottingham and Berlin. Originally established as Resource Development International (RDI) in 1990, it was later bought by Capella Education and awarded university status by the British government in 2015.
